faq1Q: How much does a stand cost?
faq1A: The price depends on the package and extras. The exact quote is on request — a manager will reach out within 15 minutes.
faq2Q: Can I change the stand size later?
faq2A: Yes. Pick a starter package, then we can grow it based on availability and budget. A manager will reach out and walk you through the options.
faq3A: Yes, entry to the event is free. After you register through the bot, we prepare a personal badge for you.
faq4Q: Do you arrange hotel and transfer?
faq4A: A list of partner hotels and transfer recommendations will be sent. Details come in a personal message after confirmation.
faq5Q: Which languages is the event held in?
faq5A: The event runs in three languages: Uzbek, Russian, English. All official materials are prepared in three languages.
